_comment: Photoreal hat models. Any style listed here loads its model instead of the procedural geometry in resources/js/tryon/hat-model.js; anything missing or broken silently falls back, so this file is safe to edit.
_calibration: file (required, relative to /models/hats/); rotation [x,y,z] radians applied first; scale multiplier applied after the loader normalises width to 2 units; offset [x,y,z] in head radii applied last. Convention: head radius 1, hat band on y=0, front facing +z.
